scenario.summary: On the Create Return page of the signed-in session, checks the order number placed by method 1 is selected, then logs off.
steps: Verify the selected order number equals the class field orderNumber
evidence: No dependsOn: the class runs by priority and shares the class field orderNumber. Methods 1-3 (priority 1-10, named 'ForRetailUser') sign in with the sheet account returnOrderGuestUserTest, place an order and work on it; methods 4-10 (priority 15-45) place a guest order and work on it. First method captures: method 1 declares the retail chain's records, method 4 (returnOrderForGuestUserVerifyCreateReturnButtonVisibleAfterTrackingOrder) the guest chain's; later methods read the class fields (SkipException DATA_UNAVAILABLE when null).

DECLARED ACCOUNT (per method): the method signs in, or works in the session signed in earlier in the class, with the sheet account testClassRetailUsers/returnOrderGuestUserTest (loginAndRegistration!B174/C174). user = USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED {store MaxwellsHardware}, preferred {source: the username source, required: true}, declared at method start with Tda.declareUser (useExisting); username/password stay credential sources (masked) the test keeps reading from its sheet. The scanner recorded the two cells only on method 1; they are declared here from the session this method reuses.
No data values; the order number is the one method 1 created (created-by-test).

returnsStore: STORE_WEBSTORE_RETURNS_ENABLED {store MaxwellsHardware} (new key, pending, user decision 2026-11-11): the store must serve a webstore and have the store global attribute EnableReturnRequest (ZnodeGlobalAttribute 1076) = true, the setting that makes Create Return available. It guarantees the store setting only; whether the order this test places is eligible (line states SHIPPED/SUBMITTED, RMA window, not already returned; Znode_GetValidateReturnOrderProduct) is decided per order and is NOT guaranteed. DB 2026-11-11 (tda rows): MaxwellsHardware (PortalId 7) has EnableReturnRequest = false (ZnodePortalGlobalAttributeValueLocale 57, modified 2026-10-31), so readiness reports GAP ZERO_ROWS: this explains the missing Create Return on atstage; the store setting must be switched on (admin, not TDA) before these tests can pass.
Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium pdp/quickOrder/plp/home entries.
